name: LibreOffice corpus: long and nested lists

slides.title: Long bullets that wrap
bullets: Price from every provider that hosts the model, per token and now per minute for audio models, with the date each price was read
Context window, maximum output and the modalities each endpoint accepts, as the provider documents them today
License and open-weights status, with a link to the license text and the date it was last checked

slides.title: A nested list three levels deep

items.text: Freeze writes to the old tables during the copy window
Announce the window to every team that writes to them
Copy the data and verify the row counts
Move the read traffic one service at a time, watching the error rate after each one
Retire the old tables after thirty days

slides.title: A numbered list
items: Write the change and its test in one pull request
Run the checks for what the branch changed
Ask for a review from someone who owns the code
Merge when the required check is green
Watch the next nightly run and revert a red main first

items.text: Support tickets from the last two quarters
Ship the first version to a pilot group

items.description: A new customer reaches first value in under a day, down from a week.
Tickets that reach engineering fell by a third after the help center rewrite.
One release every two weeks, each with notes the support team reads first.
